name: cable standing jab
description: A quick punch thrown against cable resistance builds fast, explosive pushing power. It also trains the trunk to resist twisting.
instructions: Stand facing away from the cable with the handle at chest height in one hand.
Take a staggered stance and keep your core tight.
Punch the handle forward quickly, rotating your hips a little.
Stop just before your elbow locks out.
Return the hand with control to your chin.
Do all reps, then switch arms.
